name: branding-negative-space-dog-and-bone-symbol
title: Solid black barking-dog mark built from interlocking shapes with a registered sign
whatItIs: A centred black symbol on white: a dog's head in profile, with an open jaw shown as a jagged cut, an eye dot, and a body shape that also forms a curled tail and a rounded paw, with a small ® beside it.
whatItMeans: Lively and clever; geometric cuts give the animal energy.
techniques: Build an animal from a few solid shapes and cut lines.
Use negative space for eye and jaw.
Keep the symbol a single black colour.
Let the tail form a secondary curl.
bestFor: Marks that must work at small sizes

vocabulary.definition: An animal simplified into basic shapes.
A logo in one flat colour.
